name: 06_分段渲染_ComfyUI封面_Remotion动态版式_VoxCPM_TTS

parameters.query:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM video_topics
  WHERE status = 'SCRIPT_READY'
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE video_topics AS vt
SET
  status = 'GENERATING_AUDIO',
  audio_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
FROM picked
WHERE vt.id = picked.id
RETURNING vt.*;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  voice_path = $1,
  audio_duration = $2,
  audio_engine = $3,
  render_manifest = $4::jsonb,
  status = 'AUDIO_READY',
  audio_finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $5
RETURNING id, status, voice_path, audio_duration, audio_engine, updated_at;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  status = 'GENERATING_COVER',
  media_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status, updated_at;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  cover_path = $1,
  media_engine = $2,
  media_manifest = $3::jsonb,
  comfyui_prompt_ids = $4::jsonb,
  status = 'COVER_READY',
  media_finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $5
RETURNING id, status, cover_path, media_engine, updated_at;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  status = 'RENDERING_VIDEO',
  render_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status, updated_at;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  video_path = $1,
  cover_path = $2,
  subtitle_path = $3,
  clips_json = $4::jsonb,
  render_manifest = $5::jsonb,
  voice_path = $6,
  audio_duration = $7,
  audio_engine = $8,
  shot_images_json = $9::jsonb,
  media_engine = $10,
  media_manifest = $11::jsonb,
  comfyui_prompt_ids = $12::jsonb,
  status = 'NEED_REVIEW',
  render_finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $13
RETURNING id, status, video_path, cover_path, voice_path, audio_duration, media_engine, updated_at;

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM video_topics
  WHERE id = $1
    AND review_token = $2
    AND status = 'MEDIA_READY'
    AND review_status = 'RERENDER_REQUESTED'
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE video_topics AS vt
SET
  status = 'GENERATING_AUDIO',
  audio_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  audio_finished_at = NULL,
  render_started_at = NULL,
  render_finished_at = NULL,
  error = NULL,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM picked
WHERE vt.id = picked.id
RETURNING vt.*;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  voice_path = $1,
  audio_duration = $2,
  audio_engine = $3,
  render_manifest = $4::jsonb,
  status = 'AUDIO_READY',
  audio_finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $5
RETURNING id, status, voice_path, audio_duration, audio_engine, updated_at;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  status = 'RENDERING_VIDEO',
  render_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id, status, updated_at;

nodes.name: 说明 - 正常首渲染路径

parameters.content:
## 正常首渲染路径：手动一键执行

在 n8n 里点 **Execute workflow** 会从这里开始，领取一条 `SCRIPT_READY` 记录。流程会依次生成语音/字幕、生成 ComfyUI 封面、Remotion 合成视频，最后回到 `NEED_REVIEW`。

nodes.name: 说明 - 已拒绝重渲染路径

parameters.content:
## 已拒绝重渲染路径：审核中心按钮自动触发

审核中心“已拒绝”Tab 点击 **重新渲染视频** 后，会调用 `/webhook/video-rerender-split`。这条路径只领取 `MEDIA_READY + RERENDER_REQUESTED` 记录，重新生成语音/字幕并合成视频，**跳过 ComfyUI/封面生成**，复用已有封面。

main.node: HTTP Request - Render Remotion Video Rerender

meta.description: 第五阶段：ComfyUI 只生成封面，VoxCPM 生成口播，Remotion 生成动态信息版式 final.mp4，回写 NEED_REVIEW。

description: 第六阶段：分段渲染。画布上半区是正常首渲染路径：手动执行，SCRIPT_READY -> 语音/字幕 -> ComfyUI 封面 -> Remotion 视频 -> NEED_REVIEW。画布下半区是已拒绝重渲染路径：审核中心按钮触发 /webhook/video-rerender-split，MEDIA_READY -> 语音/字幕 -> Remotion 视频 -> NEED_REVIEW，跳过 ComfyUI/封面生成。
